Yes, we’re super excited to let you know that we do ship internationally! Our beautiful custom jewellery can reach you almost anywhere in the world. For most international orders, customs charges and import duties are set by your local authorities and are the customer’s responsibility. These aren’t covered by us, so it’s a good idea to check with your local customs office if you want to avoid any surprises.

If you’re in the UK or certain European countries, import taxes and duties are already included in the price, so there are no extra charges on delivery. For US orders, there are new regulations, and a 30% tariff may apply—again, this is set by the US government and is the customer’s responsibility.

If you want to see all the details, you can check out our full shipping policy here: Shipping Policy.

We want you to love your Abbott Lyon pieces, but if they’re not quite right, here’s our return and refund policy:

Non-personalised items: You have 1 year from the purchase date to return them, as long as they’re in their original condition with packaging intact. Earrings can only be returned once per customer per year. Gift packaging, greeting cards, e-gift cards, and Advent Calendars are non-returnable.

Custom and personalised items: These can only be exchanged for a voucher for our website within 30 days of delivery. Refunds aren’t available for these items, and only one exchange per original order is allowed.
